canonical_project: Khazna Sharjah / COMTECH Freezone Kalba Tier 3 data center
owner: Khazna Sharjah JV (BEEAH Group and Khazna Data Centers), with SCTA
notes: Khazna announced the SCTA/BEEAH/Khazna collaboration for Tier 3 data centers in Sharjah, starting with the emirate's largest facility in Kalba within COMTECH Freezone; BEEAH's earlier JV announcement stated the inaugural Sharjah Tier 3 data center would have 9 MW capacity.
